lead_fa: بازی Affliction Warlock حول DoTها می‌چرخد: [[Agony]] و [[Wither]] و [[Corruption]] روی اهداف می‌مانند و خرج‌کنندهٔ تو [[Unstable Affliction]] است که با [[Soul Shards]] کست می‌شود. برست هر 2 دقیقه با [[Summon Darkglare]] می‌آید که دمیج همهٔ DoTهای فعال را 20% بالا می‌برد. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Soul Harvester]] با [[Dark Harvest]] و [[Hellcaller]] با تمرکز روی [[Wither]]؛ برچسب‌های Best منبع بین هر دو پخش شده و هر دو از دفاع‌های کلاس‌تعریف‌شدهٔ احضارکننده بهره می‌برند.

strengths: Durable spec with a large degree of survivability
Strong stacked cleave profile with short cooldowns
Provides instance skips with Demonic Gateway and Soulstone
One of the best defensive toolkits in the game
weaknesses: Ramp time for DPS can be considered higher than other specs
Lack of fast target swapping potential
Talent pathing does not allow accessing ST talents while playing AoE and vice versa

buffs: New abilities: Hedonic Gorging and Impetuous Wrath
Shard Instability now also grants a free Unstable Affliction OR Seed of Corruption (Seed of Corruption was added to it in 12.1)
nerfs: Removed abilities: Nocturnal Yield and Patient Zero
changes_12_1.note: Affliction did not receive many changes heading into patch 12.1; the spec excels at stacked AoE but severely lacks single target output in those scenarios due to limited talent pathing.

hero.recommendation: The talent page tags Hellcaller Best for Raid and Raid Cleave and Soul Harvester Best for Mythic+ and Delves, stating Hellcaller is currently the stronger Hero Talent in both single target and Mythic+ and your best overall option. The overview page however says Soul Harvester is favored in both Single Target and AoE with Hellcaller semi-substantially behind; the two pages disagree, with the talent page labels being the more specific guidance. Soul Harvester's Dark Harvest grants 3 Soul Shards every 35-40 seconds.
hero.hellcaller: Favors talents that directly increase Wither damage and amplify its effect; Malevolence is its one-minute cooldown.
hero.soul_harvester: Dark Harvest is a large contributor to its damage profile, granting 3 Soul Shards every 35-40 seconds with a cooldown reduction based on spending shards.
hero.comparison_source_note: Wowhead overview and talent page (Kalamazi, updated 2026-10-13): talent page tags Hellcaller Best for Raid/Raid Cleave and Soul Harvester Best for Mythic+/Delves; the overview text favors Soul Harvester overall. As a class, warlocks build defensives through talents like Zevrim's Resilience and Friends In Dark Places in both trees.

builds.codes_source: Wowhead Best Affliction Warlock Talent Builds page (wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/affliction/talent-builds-pve-dps), export strings captured verbatim from the page's /talent-calc/blizzard/ links on 2026-10-27; do not modify. Each hero table has four rows: Raid, Raid Cleave, Mythic+, Delves; the Mythic+ row shares the Delves string for both heroes.
builds.notes: Hellcaller carries the Best tags for Raid and Raid Cleave; Soul Harvester carries Best for Mythic+ and Delves. There may be a few scenarios where Soul Harvester is played due to its damage profile, but Hellcaller is the best overall option per the talent page.

concepts: Do not overcap Soul Shards: the resource caps at 5 and overcapping is a DPS loss; pool only heading into a damage window

Damage windows: balance pooling Soul Shards for the Summon Darkglare window every two minutes (or Malevolence every one minute as Hellcaller) while casting and maintaining Unstable Affliction; Dark Harvest grants additional shards with a cooldown reduction based on spending shards
React to procs: Shard Instability gives a free instant-cast Unstable Affliction or Seed of Corruption, so watch its stack count and do not overcap; weave Nightfall procs into your AoE window
A fairly simple generator-to-spender rotation at its core with a small handful of rules
The priority is more fluid than rigid and adapts to available resources and abilities
st_priority: Cast as many Unstable Affliction as possible
rotation.soul_harvester_st_note: As Soul Harvester the list plays without Malevolence (that one-minute cooldown belongs to Hellcaller); Dark Harvest shard generation becomes your engine.
aoe_priority: Cast Haunt on your priority target
Cast Agony on a handful of targets
Cast Seed of Corruption as many times as possible
rotation.aoe_note: Affliction AoE revolves around casting as many Seed of Corruption as possible while maintaining a few Agony and casting Dark Harvest on cooldown; Nightfall procs should be woven into the AoE window.

cooldowns.Summon Darkglare: Major cooldown on a two-minute CD; increases the damage of your active DoT effects by 20% while active, so cast it BEFORE you begin to chain cast Unstable Affliction so the damage amp covers the entire duration of the UA effects
cooldowns.Dark Harvest: Cast essentially on cooldown as long as you are not going to overcap Soul Shards; only generates Soul Shards as Soul Harvester; sync it to your Darkglare window to regenerate shards once pre-pooled shards are spent
cooldowns.Malevolence: Hellcaller's one-minute cooldown; pool and spend around it

rotation.hero_notes: Affliction is not very complicated in Midnight even with Unstable Affliction returning as your spender. Refreshing DoTs before the Pandemic window is a small DPS loss worth min-maxing, but refreshing DoTs on the move is a DPS gain over casting nothing: the spec is incredibly mobile. Pandemic ranges: Agony 4.5 seconds, Corruption/Wither 4.2 seconds.
opener: Cast as many Unstable Affliction as possible
Proceed onto the normal priority list
soul_harvester_opener: Continue with the Soul Harvester priority (no Malevolence)
pre_combat: Get your food buff and oil applied
Cast Create Soulwell so every party or raid member can grab a Healthstone
Place your portals as needed: personal Demonic Circle and group Demonic Gateway
Double check your talents for the boss ahead

gear.gearing_rules: General guideline: Haste > Critical Strike > Mastery > Versatility. Do not neglect Intellect: a substantial item level increase is typically worth it compared to optimized stats. Affliction usually likes a mix of all secondary stats but favors Haste and Critical Strike; item level greatly influences a piece's value. Sim with Raidbots.

tier_set.name: Damned Necrolyte's Shattered Restraints
tier_set.note: 2pc: Wither/Corruption damage increased by 25% and Agony damage increased by 15%. 4pc: each active Unstable Affliction increases your damage dealt by spells and abilities by 2% up to 6%, and Seed of Corruption applies Unstable Affliction at 20% effectiveness to your target; most of the set's power sits behind the stacking 4-piece.

stats.cheatsheet: Intellect > Haste > Critical Strike > Mastery > Versatility; identical for Hellcaller and Soul Harvester.
notes: Intellect is your primary stat on cloth gear: it increases spell power and damage.
Mastery increases the damage done by your DoTs and other Affliction based effects.
Critical Strike gives a chance for extra effectiveness on attacks.
Affliction likes a mix of all secondary stats but favors Haste and Critical Strike; item level greatly influences a piece's value.

mplus.hero_note: Soul Harvester carries the Best tag for Mythic+ this season with Hellcaller close behind in single target; stacked cleave with short cooldowns is the spec's strength while ramp time and slow target swapping are its weakness. The AoE game revolves around Seed of Corruption spam.
tips: Cast Seed of Corruption as many times as possible and keep Agony on a handful of targets
Weave Nightfall procs into your AoE window; Shard Instability now also grants free Seed of Corruption casts
Do not overcap Soul Shards at 5: pool only ahead of the Summon Darkglare window
Haunt your priority target and let the DoTs do the rest
Demonic Gateway and Soulstone enable instance skips and raid utility
